description:
Brand introduction:

Battle Toss is a dynamic social game that brings people together, blending classic party games with modern twists. Designed for both indoor and outdoor fun, Battle Toss provides an engaging experience that is perfect for casual get-togethers, tailgates, or lively gatherings. We’re committed to creating high-quality, versatile games that spark friendly competition and lasting memories.

Product description: 

Battle Toss combines the strategic fun of Connect Four, the toss-and-target element of cornhole, and the social thrill of beer pong. Players take turns tossing balls with the goal of aligning four in a row, vertically, horizontally or diagonal. The game is adaptable, offering ground-based or wall-mounted setups, making it perfect for any setting—from backyards to bars. Built with durable, weather-resistant materials, Battle Toss is designed to withstand hours of entertainment, whether indoors or outdoors.

USP (Unique Selling Point): 

Battle Toss stands out by offering unparalleled versatility and innovative game design. It’s the only game that seamlessly combines elements of classic party favorites, allowing for multiple playing styles. Its flexible design can be easily mounted on a wall or played on the ground, making it adaptable for any event or venue. Additionally, its appeal to both casual and competitive players makes it a must-have for gatherings of all kinds.

Other information:

Ideal for restaurants, bars, and event spaces, Battle Toss has been designed to enhance customer experiences and encourage social engagement during major events, including football season.

We also offer an affiliate program with 5% commission on sales and a 5% discount code for customers.
